entry.name: live.slider
entry.digest: Output numbers by moving a slider onscreen
entry.description: live.slider is a user interface object that resembles a sliding potentiometer.

attributes.name: param_connect
attributes.digest: Connect to Parameter
attributes.description: Establishes a two-way connection between the object and a parameter of a compatible object with parameters such asor. The object can be used to change the value of the parameter and will update if the parameter value changes. The easiest way to setis with the attribute's menu in theor the Connect submenu of the. The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: Click and drag in the slider to change the value.
messages.description: Click and drag in the slider to change the value. Hold down the Shift key for more precise mouse control.

messages.name: assign
messages.description: The word, followed by a floating point value, causes that value to be displayed and sent out theobject's outlet. The value, however, will not be stored. If the Parameter Visibility attribute is set to Stored Only, themessage will not add the new value to the Live application’s undo chain.

messages.description: The number received in the inlet is stored and displayed by theobject and sent out the outlet.

messages.digest: Restore and output the initial value
messages.description: Restore and output the initial value.

messages.digest: Store, display, and output a number

messages.description: Sends the current value out the outlet.

messages.name: rawfloat
messages.digest: Store a raw normalized value, convert to real, display, and output
messages.description: A raw normalized value (between 0. and 1.) received in the inlet is converted to a real value, stored, displayed by, and the current value is sent out the outlet.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set and display the current value without triggering output
messages.description: Sets and displays the current value without triggering any output.
